name: @epoch/billing-host
description: Epoch Billing HOST (W024, service layer) — the thin typed runtime facade over the @epoch/entitlements kernel: billing-account sessions (idempotent opening; one settlement currency per account), W023 entitlement grant/revocation adoption (verified through the REAL marketplace validators; idempotent by entitlement id), W036 sealed-delivery registration (verified at admission; only VALIDATED actuals ever bill), sealed usage-event intake (idempotent by (stream, sequence); folded through the REAL marketplace fold), seat assignment/release operations (kernel admission: capacity, duplicates, revocation; events on the entitlement stream), invoice draft -> issued -> settled | void sessions with kernel-derived lines (one-time / subscription / seat / usage / delivery-actual; exact decimal arithmetic), settlement-port registration and check passthrough (the port outcome proposes the settled transition — the invoice record is the authority, never the port state), tenant-scoped reads (R12), and health/liveness as typed data. The W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized operations BEFORE any kernel admission; every lifecycle step emits billing:*/entitlements:* events (W010-shaped, one stream per billing account / per entitlement, digests sealed by the kernel). NO persistence, NO network, NO real processes, NO wall-clock, NO randomness — every instant is caller-supplied.
